---
title: "PIVOT"
description: "Participatory GIS and scenario planning for environmental decision-making."
---

<div class="page-intro">PIVOT is a modular web-based platform for mapping local knowledge, identifying priorities, comparing scenarios, and linking community input with environmental and urban models.</div>

## Research focus

PIVOT is designed around a central question: how can **community knowledge and preferences** be incorporated into environmental planning in a way that is transparent, spatially explicit, and useful for decision-makers?

The platform supports participatory mapping, comparison across places and scenarios, and integration with modeled environmental information.

## Applications

PIVOT has been developed for work on flood resilience, climate adaptation, urban planning, and related environmental decision-support applications in Great Lakes communities and East Africa.

## Methods & infrastructure

Participatory GIS · Shiny and Leaflet · spatial databases · scenario planning · geovisualization · model integration
